Baserow (https://baserow.io) | Product Specialist | REMOTE (Europe) | Full-time | German-speaking

We're building an open-source no-code platform for databases, applications, and automations.

We're looking for a technical, customer-facing Product Specialist to help customers build solutions with Baserow. Ideal experience includes Airtable, n8n, APIs, databases, and automation. Fluent German and English required.

Remote-first, flexible hours, competitive salary + stock options.

Details & apply: https://baserow.io/jobs/product-specialist-baserow
